content.snl: %The package manifest for SNL-Basics version 0.4.0 in its public beta series. The package name is @sjtu-ai4math/snl-basics, and its public entry points expose SNL syntax-tree parsing, KaTeX-in-React rendering, and complete Entry rendering. Macro data remains consumer-owned. Publication status is external registry state and is not inferred from repository metadata. The package.json#files allowlist includes dist-lib and the maintained package documentation and license files.%
content.markdown: The package manifest for SNL-Basics version `0.4.0` in its public beta series. The package name is `@sjtu-ai4math/snl-basics`, and its public entry points expose SNL syntax-tree parsing, KaTeX-in-React rendering, and complete Entry rendering. Macro data remains consumer-owned. Publication status is external registry state and is not inferred from repository metadata. The `package.json#files` allowlist includes `dist-lib`, `README.md`, `README(ZH).md`, `MIGRATION.md`, and `LICENSE`.

content.snl: %A pure-TypeScript syntax-tree module with no React, KaTeX, or DOM dependencies. It is responsible for parsing, serializing, and annotating SNL source as SnlSyntaxTree. SNL-Agent-Toolkit imports this module’s parser and types directly through a deep path.%
content.markdown: A pure-TypeScript syntax-tree module with no React, KaTeX, or DOM dependencies. It is responsible for parsing, serializing, and annotating SNL source as `SnlSyntaxTree`. SNL-Agent-Toolkit imports this module’s parser and types directly through a deep path.

content.snl: %Query-oriented macro data model. It defines SnlMacro, SnlMacroStyle, SnlMacroSource, MacroDataQueries, and MacroDataDriver. Consumers own storage and provide query_macro.%
content.markdown: Query-oriented macro data model. It defines `SnlMacro`, `SnlMacroStyle`, `SnlMacroSource`, `MacroDataQueries`, and `MacroDataDriver`. Consumers own storage and provide `query_macro`.

content.snl: %The React component layer, which depends on KaTeX and React. It provides the main SnlSyntaxTreeView rendering component, the SnlSyntaxTreeEditor editor, and a complete rendering infrastructure including hooks, a palette, a DB loader, and a block-renderer registry.%
content.markdown: The React component layer, which depends on KaTeX and React. It provides the main `SnlSyntaxTreeView` rendering component, the `SnlSyntaxTreeEditor` editor, and a complete rendering infrastructure including hooks, a palette, a DB loader, and a block-renderer registry.

content.snl: %Ten kinds are used: NpmPackage, Module, Interface, Class, Field, Function, ReactComponent, Property, Constant, and Concept. Interface members are documented within content rather than as separate entries. Class members receive separate subentries. Methods reuse Function; the full name Property avoids ambiguity with Lean’s Prop = Proposition; and default implementations reuse Constant.%
content.markdown: Ten kinds are used: `NpmPackage`, `Module`, `Interface`, `Class`, `Field`, `Function`, `ReactComponent`, `Property`, `Constant`, and `Concept`. Interface members are documented within `content` rather than as separate entries. Class members receive separate subentries. Methods reuse `Function`; the full name `Property` avoids ambiguity with Lean’s `Prop = Proposition`; and default implementations reuse `Constant`.
Globally unique name, e.g. "FOL.eq", "FOL.forall", "FOL.forall.typed"
Human-readable description shown in tooltips / docs.
Source-of-truth binding. Resolver: entries[0..] first valid, else urls[0], else null.
Semantic kind (rule / const / bvar / binder / fvar / custom). If unset, nodes rendered for this macro get `data-kind="fvar"`. (There is no more `'default'` kind — un-classified = fvar.)

True when the macro's child count is not fixed by its template — its default (styles[0]) template must contain `#*`. All styles must agree on this flag; it's a macro-level invariant so switching styles never changes the arity contract at the call site.

All render styles in order. `styles[0]` is the **implicit default** used when the SNL source omits `[style]`. In `foo[bar](x)`, the parser picks the style whose `tag === "bar"`; unknown tags are a render-time error. Every macro has at least one style. Style tags follow `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*` (parser IDENT rules) and must be unique within this array.

Binder names already in scope OUTSIDE this fragment — used by annotate-bind to decide bvar vs fvar for delimited-name leaves whose name matches an enclosing binder. Defaults to empty (context-free). Consumers that parse a subtree in isolation (e.g. an incremental editor re-parsing one node) should pass the enclosing tree's currently-active binder names here so the sub-parse resolves bvar/fvar correctly.

title: MacroDataDriver
body: Query-only macro data source with bounded LRU cache and in-flight deduplication. All macro lookups go through `query_macro()`. Added in v0.10.0.

title: MacroDataQueries
body: Injectable backend interface for MacroDataDriver. Consumers implement `query_macro({macro_name, signal?}): Promise<SnlMacro|null>` to plug in their data source.

title: $\texttt{query\_macro}$
body: Asynchronously queries one macro by macro_name and returns null when it is not found.

title: SnlInteractionDriver
body: Injectable interaction handler for SnlSyntaxTreeView. Class-based, async-capable. Dispatches hover/leave/click/ctrl-click with full modifier key context. ctrl_key means literal Ctrl (NOT macOS Meta). Added in v0.10.0.

title: SnlInteractionContext
body: Full context passed to interaction callbacks: node, tree_path, macro|null, target element, client_x/y, and modifier keys (ctrl_key, meta_key, shift_key, alt_key).

title: Schema Migration Module
body: Centralized schema migration chains (src/schema/) from supported legacy documents to current macro v11 and tree v3, with retained stepwise migrations, version constants, validation, and CLI tooling.

title: migrateMacroDocument
body: Migrates an entire macro DB through the retained v6→v7→v9→v10→v11 chain to current v11. The first step maps tag→style_name, the variadic triple→separator+template, and react_renderer_key→block_template_name, and adds tags:[].

title: migrateSyntaxTreeDocument
body: Migrates a syntax tree recursively through the retained v1→v2→v3 chain to current v3. The first step maps name→macro_name, style→style_name, and envMode→env_mode.

title: MACRO_SCHEMA_VERSION
body: Current macro schema version (11). Used for version detection in migrations.

title: TREE_SCHEMA_VERSION
body: Current syntax tree schema version (3). Used for version detection in migrations.

content.markdown: Optional delegated interaction driver for hover, leave, click, and Ctrl-click callbacks.
The tree-shakeable `@sjtu-ai4math/snl-basics/entry` route. It renders complete query-backed Entry cards while keeping Markdown dependencies outside the package-root import graph.
Query-only Entry and EntryKind access with a bounded hit-and-miss LRU, unsignalled in-flight deduplication, independent caller cancellation, and epoch-safe cache clearing.
The injected storage-neutral backend: `query_entry` and `query_entry_kind`, each with an optional AbortSignal.
Renders a loaded Entry as a kind-colored card. Body precedence is nonblank SNL, Markdown, LaTeX, text, then header-only empty state.
Queries one Entry and its EntryKind, aborts stale work, and renders loading, missing, error, or ready state without projecting a prior driver identity.
Provides recursive, dismissible Entry previews derived from queried macro `source.entries`, reusing the same Entry and Macro drivers.
Queries every unique `mdata.src` Entry, upgrades matching source-bound variables to `bvar`, and records `dangling` or `srcResolvedNoDecl` status without storage assumptions.
